thread:
kevin: heads-up — RFC follow-up idea: automate affinity revocation when agent heartbeat misses for N intervals instead of manual ops. thoughts?

maya: automation good, but we need guardrails. accidental network partition could cause mass revokes. suggest progressive backoff (30s -> 2m -> 10m) and a circuit-breaker per-region.

ranjit: agree on backoff. also need a two-phase revoke: soft-revoke (mark affinity stale, start telemetry only) then hard-revoke (reassign to relay). gives time for transient flaps.

zoe: what about certs? if we hard-revoke we must revoke/mint proxy certs atomically so apps don't see cert mismatch. can't wait on CRL propagation.

maya: proxy cert plan: use short-lived certs (90s) for affinity path and rotate on revoke. hard-revoke triggers immediate issuance of a relay cert and invalidates lease token. no long-lived CRL needed.

kevin: nice. how do we prevent thundering herd when a region has outage and many tenants revoke?

ranjit: rate-limit reassignments per-region and queue cutovers. use randomized jitter per-tenant cutover window. emit metric queued_cutovers. ops-runbook will describe emergency mass-failover mode (manual override).

zoe: audit trail requirement: every revoke must generate signed attestation record with tenant-id, revoke-cause, operator-job-id. store in per-tenant audit stream. customers can opt-in to push these to their S3.

maya: add monitoring: revokes_by_cause, soft_revokes, hard_revokes, reassign_retries. alert if hard_revokes > 5% in 10m.

kevin: config sketch:```yaml
tenant: foo-inc
affinity: enabled
revocation_policy:
  soft_ttl: 30s
  hard_after: 3m
  backoff_windows: [30s, 2m, 10m]
  allow_fallback: true
  max_concurrent_reassign: 10
```

ranjit: cutover sequence suggestion:
1) heartbeat miss > soft_ttl -> mark stale, emit event
2) wait backoff window, probe agent via controlplane relay
3) if no recovery and time > hard_after -> mint relay proxy-cert, set route to relay, increment metric
4) operator can trigger rollback via API (manual) or agents auto-recover and re-request lease

zoe: test matrix: single-agent failure, AZ failure, region partition, and delayed certificate issuance. include chaos test that simulates 500 simultaneous revokes.

infra-bot: rollout task created: affinity-revocation-automation -> canary (build 0.38.1) :rocket:

kevin: ok i'll write RFC follow-up with policy examples, attestation schema, metrics, and runbook. pinging @maya @ranjit for review. :+1:
